name: workbuddy-token-usage
description: 只读查询 WorkBuddy 本地用量（上下文占比 + credit，数据来自 ~/.workbuddy/workbuddy.db），提供 token_usage MCP 工具与 /usage 命令。不改客户端文件、不注入 asar、不联网。
description_en: Read-only local usage for WorkBuddy (context usage + credits from ~/.workbuddy/workbuddy.db) via the token_usage MCP tool and the /usage command. No client modification, no asar injection, no network.
